review.notes: Full re-review. The five findings of the previous review are repaired. Sample: the 15 seeded targets; locators read in Chung (revised chapters 1-2), Gretton et al. 2012, Sutherland-Schneider 2015, Sriperumbudur et al. 2010, Gorham-Mackey 2017, Genovese et al. 2012; sixteen books not readable (listed under Not verifiable). Adversarial pass over every statement with computed values (28 rows). Automatic checks: dependency check 0 problems, elaboration 49 sorry and no error, one-tactic probe on six theorems (none closes), one form check set aside as a false positive. Findings: two prose targets lack a hypothesis and are false without it (11.3 operator form, counterexample computed; 10.1 unbiasedness at n = 1).
